class.name: StreamedTexture2D
class.brief_description: A texture that supports dynamic mipmap streaming for optimized VRAM usage.
class.description: StreamedTexture2D is a texture type that supports dynamic mipmap streaming. When texture streaming is enabled in the Project Settings ([member ProjectSettings.rendering/textures/streaming/enabled]), these textures can have their mipmap levels dynamically loaded and unloaded based on usage. The texture streaming system monitors which textures are visible in each frame and at what resolution they're being displayed. Textures that are far from the camera or not currently visible have their higher-resolution mipmap levels unloaded to save VRAM, while textures being displayed up close are loaded at higher resolutions. This texture type is automatically created when importing images with the streaming-compatible importer.

method.name: create_from_provider
method.description: Creates a native streamed texture from original mip data without an imported file. Streaming must be enabled on Forward+ or Mobile. [param initial_image] contains the complete mip suffix beginning at [param initial_mip], in its native format, while [param original_size] retains the full-resolution dimensions. The thread-safe provider accepts an original mip index and synchronously returns a fresh [Image] with exactly that mip and all smaller levels through 1x1. Format and dimensions must match the source. Godot owns requests, budgeting, uploads and RID replacement. The callback runs on the texture I/O thread, must not schedule asynchronous completion, destroy streamed textures, recursively request provider images, or drain providers from inside itself. It must not retain streamed textures in its captured state. The caller must keep the callback target valid. All provider callables are owned by native streaming state rather than this resource. Call [method TextureStreaming.remove_providers] with [param owner] before unloading an extension that implements them. After that barrier returns, no callable invocation or destructor for this owner remains; new registrations using that owner are rejected. Existing texture resources retain their last native image but are detached from streaming.

method.name: get_current_mip
method.description: Returns the successfully submitted resident source mip, or [code]-1[/code] after its provider owner has been drained. The logical resource dimensions remain the original size.

method.name: get_streaming_error
method.description: Returns the latest provider validation/load error, [constant OK] while healthy, or [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] after owner drain. A failed request does not advance residency and suspends further requests until [method retry_streaming].

method.name: load
method.description: Loads the texture from the specified [param path].

method.name: retry_streaming
method.description: Clears a provider failure so native feedback can request a mip again. Does not change residency or restart a drained owner.

members.member: The [StreamedTexture2D]'s file path to a [code].stex[/code] file.

Overrides the maximum LOD (mipmap level) that can be loaded for this specific texture. Lower values allow higher resolution. A value of [code]0[/code] uses the global setting from [member ProjectSettings.rendering/textures/streaming/max_lod]. Values [code]1[/code] to [code]14[/code] correspond to LOD levels [code]0[/code] to [code]13[/code].

Overrides the minimum LOD (mipmap level) this texture starts at when loaded. Higher values result in lower initial resolution. A value of [code]0[/code] uses the global setting from [member ProjectSettings.rendering/textures/streaming/min_lod]. Values [code]1[/code] to [code]14[/code] correspond to LOD levels [code]0[/code] to [code]13[/code].
